title: Quantum photonic neural networks in time
summary: We introduce the architecture and timing algorithm to realize a time-bin-encoded quantum photonic neural network (QPNN): a reconfigurable nonlinear photonic circuit inspired by the brain and trained to process quantum information. Unlike the typical spatially-encoded QPNN, time-encoded networks require the same number of photonic elements (e.g. phase shifters or switches) regardless of their size or depth.
